context_card.cerita: Pagi ini semua orang di foto keluarga punya kumis tebal, termasuk Nenek. Fotonya pasti sempat diturunkan dan dicoret kemarin sore. Dimas langsung dituduh, tapi ia bersumpah kali ini bukan dia.

clue_awal.teks: Spidol hanya ada di Ruang Kerja dan tidak boleh dibawa keluar. Kalau pakai spidol, pasti dicoret di sana.
Raka merekam konten di Ruang Kerja sepanjang sore dan tidak keluar sama sekali.

rt_foto.teks: Di balik bingkai foto terselip daun belimbing kering. Pohon belimbing hanya tumbuh di teras.

rt_meja.teks: Gulungan selotip di meja kopi masih bersegel plastik. Belum pernah dibuka sama sekali.

rt_kursi.teks: Ada kuas kecil di kursi mustard. Bulunya masih basah oleh cat air hitam.

rt_lukisan.teks: Di samping lukisan, paku foto keluarga longgar. Fotonya sempat diturunkan dan dibawa keluar dari ruang tamu.

rt_rak.teks: Kamera Raka di rak buku berisi rekaman Ruang Kerja sepanjang sore. Foto keluarga tak sekali pun muncul.

rt_sofa.teks: Terselip pembatas buku farmasi di sela bantal sofa. Ujungnya bernoda hitam.

rt_jam.teks: Jam dinding berdetak santai, seolah tidak terjadi apa-apa.

rt_keset.teks: Sandal berjajar rapi. Ada satu sandal kiri tanpa pasangan, seperti biasa.

rt_kolong.teks: Kolong sofa: dua tutup pulpen dan bulu Si Belang segenggam.

rt_telepon.teks: Nada sambungnya normal. Tidak ada pesan yang tertinggal.

rt_tirai.teks: Tirainya wangi sabun. Mbok Sri baru mencucinya minggu lalu.

rt_lemari.teks: Isinya buku telepon, lilin, dan korek api untuk kalau mati lampu.

teks_kosong_bawaan: Tidak ada yang aneh di sini.

penjelasan.teks: Pelakunya bertangan kanan, jadi Dimas memang tidak bersalah kali ini.
Daun belimbing di balik bingkai: fotonya dicoret di teras.
Raka tidak keluar dari Ruang Kerja, jadi bukan dia. Pelakunya Sekar.
Kuas basah cat air di kursi mustard: kumisnya dilukis dengan cat air.

komentar_nenek: Sekar, Nenek tahu Dimas sering jahil. Tapi balasnya jangan ke foto keluarga, Nenek jadi ikut berkumis.

en.cerita: This morning everyone in the family photo has a thick mustache, Grandma included. The photo must have been taken down and drawn on yesterday afternoon. Everyone blamed Dimas right away, but he swears it wasn't him this time.

clue_awal.A2: The only markers are in the Study, and they're not allowed out. If a marker was used, it was done there.
clue_awal.A3: Raka was filming content in the Study all afternoon and never left.

benda.rt_foto: A dry starfruit leaf is tucked behind the photo frame. Starfruit only grows on the porch.
benda.rt_meja: The roll of tape on the coffee table is still sealed in plastic. It's never been opened.
benda.rt_kursi: There's a small brush on the mustard armchair. Its bristles are still wet with black watercolor.
benda.rt_lukisan: Next to the painting, the nail for the family photo is loose. The photo was taken down and carried out of the living room.
benda.rt_rak: Raka's camera on the bookshelf holds footage of the Study all afternoon. The family photo never appears once.
benda.rt_sofa: A pharmacy bookmark is wedged between the sofa cushions. Its tip is stained black.
benda.rt_jam: The wall clock ticks along calmly, as if nothing happened.
benda.rt_keset: The sandals are lined up neatly. There's one left sandal without a partner, as usual.
benda.rt_kolong: Under the sofa: two pen caps and a handful of Belang's fur.
benda.rt_telepon: The dial tone is normal. No messages left.
benda.rt_tirai: The curtains smell of soap. Mbok Sri washed them just last week.
benda.rt_lemari: Inside: phone books, candles, and matches for when the power goes out.

penjelasan: The culprit is right-handed, so Dimas really is innocent this time.
A starfruit leaf behind the frame: the photo was drawn on at the porch.
Raka never left the Study, so it wasn't him. The culprit is Sekar.
A brush wet with watercolor on the armchair: the mustaches were painted with watercolor.
en.komentar_nenek: Sekar, Grandma knows Dimas pranks you a lot. But don't get back at him through the family photo. Now Grandma has a mustache too.
